resumen: Lying face down, you lift the straight arms and the legs off the floor at the same time, and hold at the top. It works the back muscles without equipment.
ejecucion: Lie face down with your arms stretched out in front and your legs straight.
Look at the floor so your neck stays in line with your back.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor at the same time, and hold.
Lower under control and rest before repeating.
If you feel your lower back, lift less: raising your arms and legs a little is enough.
With low back discomfort, swap this exercise for the bird dog.
matices: In a study that graded several lumbar stabilisation exercises in ten healthy men, holding the superman longer added up to more total activity in the multifidus, erectors and rectus abdominis. Another, in thirteen men, found the highest lumbar load in the extension exercises that move the trunk, and much less when extending just one leg with the back still. That is why, with low back discomfort, the bird dog is a better place to start.
